name: fioInit
evidence: sceSifInitRpc + sceSifBindRpc(0x80000001) loop + sceSifCallRpc fno 0xff; sets DAT_00412fc4=1 (init flag); called only by the fio wrappers when flag==0 (already named)

name: fioOpen
evidence: fno 0 (open); args (name,flags,mode); allocates fd slot in 0x20-entry table; 9 callers

name: fioClose
evidence: fno 1 (close); args (fd); frees fd slot; 11 callers; does not call fioInit (returns -1 if DAT_00412fc4==0)

name: fioRead
evidence: fno 2 (read); args (fd,buf,size); 6 callers; no fioInit call

name: fioWrite
evidence: fno 3 (write); args (fd,buf,size); 1 caller; no fioInit call

name: fioLseek

name: fioIoctl
evidence: fno 5 (ioctl); args (fd,cmd,arg); cmd 1/2/3 handled locally (fd-table queries) else RPC with 0x400-byte arg copy; 4 callers; calls fioInit

name: fioRemove
